text:
maya: Quick follow-up from the INC-5423 postmortem — recurring KV-cache eviction pattern causing intermittent p99 latency spikes. Link: https://intranet.redwood/postmortem/INC-5423 :eyes:
maya: Need runbook/playbook updates: explicit triage steps, exact commands, escalation ladder (on-call -> infra lead -> exec on-call), and an action owner for remediation sprint. Please ack with owner + ETA by EOD today.
sanjay: I can own runbook triage edits. I'll add a troubleshooting checklist and the exact commands. ETA: 2026-03-25.

tess: Can someone paste the kubectl + evict commands so I can validate them in staging?
sanjay: Paste: ```kubectl -n inference logs -l app=redwood-runtime --since=30m | grep -i KVCache
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=redwood-runtime -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}' | xargs -I{} kubectl -n inference exec -it {} -- /bin/sh -c 'curl -sS localhost:9090/debug/cache/evict'``` Put these under runbook -> triage -> collect logs and runbook -> mitigate -> force-evict.

ev an: I'll own the escalation-policy text and when to page: suggest paging infra if the eviction signature hits 3 times in 24h OR if p99 latency delta > 200ms for the inference service. ETA: 2026-03-26.

ops-bot: Created INF-7891 and linked to the postmortem: https://tickets.redwood/INF-7891 (runbook edits + sprint task)

luca: I'll block 2 dev-days in next sprint for the runbook review and staging validation. I'll review PRs.

maya: Please attach PR links to the postmortem doc and tag with `postmortem-followup` and `runbook-update`. If you need more time, speak up. :thumbsup:

sanjay: Ran the evict flow in staging; no side effects. Opening PR by EOD Monday.

(72h later)

sanjay: PR merged: https://git.redwood/runbooks/commit/4f2a9a — added triage checklist, commands, and quick mitigation steps. INF-7891 status: in-review -> done.

maya: Great. Next: automating detection. Can we add a monitor for the 3x/24h pattern to auto-create a ticket and page infra? Adding as follow-up on INF-7891.

ev an: I'll spike a monitor (Datadog/Prometheus alert) and report back next week.

luca: Confirmed runbook updated, sprint allocation used, and follow-ups tracked in INF-7891. Closing loop on postmortem action items. :white_check_mark:
